axioms.name: si_definition_c
axioms.note: definitional (BIPM SI): c = 299,792,458 m/s exactly; the meter is defined from c (1983/2019). Computing this number is unit bookkeeping, not derivation

axioms.name: maxwell_em_wave_speed
axioms.note: empirical law (Maxwell 1865): electromagnetic waves propagate at 1/sqrt(mu0*eps0); identifying this with optical speed is the historical derivation of c as an EM quantity

axioms.name: historical_determinations_empirical
axioms.note: empirical: Weber-Kohlrausch 1856 (310,740,000 m/s), Fizeau 1849 (313,300,000), Foucault 1862 (298,000,000) are measured/computed determinations

axioms.name: ignatowski_premises
axioms.note: premises (von Ignatowski 1910): relativity principle + homogeneity + isotropy + causality imply a linear coordinate law containing an invariant speed

axioms.name: lieb_robinson_theorem
axioms.note: rigorous theorem (Lieb-Robinson 1972): commutator propagation in lattice systems is bounded by v = 2Ja; modeling premise: such Hamiltonians describe physical signal propagation

axioms.name: alpha_empirical
axioms.note: empirical (CODATA 2018): alpha = 7.2973525693(11) x 10^-3; the fine-structure constant is MEASURED, not derived

axioms.name: wave_scheme_represents_wave
axioms.note: modeling premise: the integer scheme u_{t+1}(x) = u_t(x+1) + u_t(x-1) - u_{t-1}(x) faithfully discretizes u_tt = c^2 u_xx at c = 1, dx = dt = 1

lemmas.name: lr_bound_nonneg
lemmas.gap: requires positivity reasoning (Mathlib mul_nonneg/positivity) or manual case analysis; symbolic content of the Lieb-Robinson velocity computed concretely in scripts/column3/05_lr_bound.py

lemmas.name: inv_alpha_interval_general
lemmas.type: ∀ (α lo hi : ℚ), 0 < lo → lo ≤ α → α ≤ hi → 1/hi ≤ 1/α ∧ 1/α ≤ 1/lo
lemmas.gap: requires field_simp + order reasoning (Mathlib) or manual cross-multiplication with positivity; general shape of the uncertainty inversion verified concretely in scripts/column3/06_alpha_boundary.py

lemmas.name: alpha_from_premises
lemmas.gap: DELIBERATE TARGET, EXPECTED UNPROVEN: a parameter-free derivation of the fine-structure constant (equivalently, of c's dimensionless value) from theory alone. No accepted derivation exists; numerology-class claims (Eddington lineage and modern preprints) are registered WOULD_BE_GUESS in the ledgers. Keeping this sorry is the formal boundary of the study: everything else about c is derivable, this is not
